# Remove AI Label from Your Photos — Instantly, Free.
## Why does Instagram (and other platforms) show AI Info?
Automated systems scan uploads for C2PA, XMP, and related fields — which is why creators search “why does my Instagram post say AI Info” even on mostly real photos.

## What is AI Info / AI label on your photo?
“AI Info” (Meta) and “Made with AI” refer to disclosure when your upload still contains C2PA or XMP tied to AI creation or editing.

## What is image metadata? (C2PA, XMP, EXIF explained)
Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, and TikTok often read these on upload for transparency labels — not a full pixel classifier on every file.

## Why do platforms add AI labels?
Meta uses the C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) standard to automatically detect AI metadata and displays an "AI Info" or "Made with AI" tag on labeled content.

## What We Remove
Metadata that triggers AI labels on Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook, and TikTok.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Optional first step: run the free metadata checker to see whether C2PA, XMP, or PNG chunks are present. Then upload your JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF to the remover above with C2PA and XMP enabled, download the cleaned file, and upload that file to Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or Pinterest.

AI Info is Meta’s label when your file contains AI provenance metadata (usually C2PA or XMP) — not necessarily that every pixel is synthetic.

C2PA is a newer cryptographic standard used by platforms to verify and track content provenance.

web.description:
# How Meta Labels AI Content in Facebook and Instagram Ads (2026)
Here is what triggers the AI info label in Ads Manager, how C2PA detection works, and the penalties for skipping it.

Open any ad on Instagram or Facebook in 2026, tap the three dots, and a line reading "AI info" now sits in the "About this ad" section on a growing share of them.

## The rollout came in two stages
That label came partly from creators disclosing it themselves and partly from Meta reading industry-shared signals in the file.

## What trips the AI label
Third-party tools like Photoshop generative fill, DALL-E, Firefly and Canva trigger it too, because Meta reads the C2PA Content Credentials those tools bake into the file and labels the ad the moment it is uploaded.

## Where the label shows up
The AI info panel shows one of two lines.

The disclosure is public.

## Meta is not the only one
TikTok has read the same C2PA credentials to auto-label AI clips since 2024, and treats the label as disclosure rather than a reach penalty, so tagged content still earns through the Creator Fund.
